# openstatus_status_page_component_group (Resource)

Manages a status page component group.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "openstatus_status_page_component_group" "infrastructure" {
  page_id      = openstatus_status_page.main.id
  name         = "Infrastructure"
  default_open = true
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String)
- `page_id` (String)

### Optional

- `default_open` (Boolean) Whether the group should be expanded by default on the status page.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String)
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `updated_at` (String)
